title: ALMA Observations of Polarized Emission toward the CW Tau and DG Tau Protoplanetary Disks: Constraints on Dust Grain Growth and Settling
question: What are the polarization properties of the 870 um dust emission in the CW Tau and DG Tau disks, and what do they imply for grain growth and settling?
